references.text: The inhabitants of Gibeon heard about Joshua's victories, which led them to seek peace with Israel
Gibeon is mentioned as one of the cities of the Hivites that made a covenant with Israel
Describes the destruction of Ai, the city compared in size to Gibeon
Gibeon is described as an important city, larger than Ai
Fear falling upon the peoples of the land because of Israel's entry
The Lord puts fear and dread of Israel over all the peoples
Rahab describes how fear has fallen upon the inhabitants of Canaan because of Israel
